recommendation: Provide navigation and support services for housing-insecure patients
implementation_steps: Serve as bridge between patients and health/social services systems
Provide psychosocial support, health education, and advocacy
Assist with navigation of healthcare and housing service systems
Accompany patients to appointments when needed
Help with housing application paperwork and documentation requirements
evidence_summary: CHW-led navigation and support interventions have demonstrated improvements in housing stability, healthcare engagement, and health outcomes for patients experiencing housing insecurity.
